newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan central bank net profit falls in 1995/96.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan central bank net profit falls in 1995/96.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan (SBP) said on Thursday its net profit fell to 13.7 billion rupees ($340.6 million) in fiscal 1995/96 from 21.2 billion rupees in 1994/95.
The SBP said in its annual report that it had lost 11.2 billion rupees in risk cover on foreign currency deposits.
"Gross earnings during 1995/96 (July-June) amounted to 29.7 billion rupees compared with 23.8 billion in the last year.
"However, the bank incurred a loss of 11.2 billion on account of exchange risk cover provided on foreign currency deposits in sharp contrast to a gain of 2.1 billion during 1994/95," the report said.
Net earnings fell to 18.45 billion rupees from 25.94 billion in 1994/95.
After making provision for payment of dividend and appropriations for different funds, 13 billion rupees became payable as surplus to the federal government, the bank said.
